info.name: v11_VillagKart_Telugu_Flow
info.description:
Complete API collection for VillagKart Customer Mobile App.

**Folders:** 00 Health, 01 Auth, 02 Serviceability, 03 Categories, 04 Subcategories, 05 Products, 06 Brands, 07 Coupons, 08 Cart, 09 Addresses, 10 Delivery, 11 Orders, 12 Payments, 13 Returns, 14 Notifications, 15 Ratings & Reviews, 16 Wishlist, 17 Chat, 18 App & Misc, 19 E2E Test, 20 Internal (order sync).

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection and the environment (VillagKart_Environment.postman_environment.json).
2. Set `base_url` (e.g. http://localhost:3003), `phone`, `pincode`.
3. Run "01. Authentication" → Send OTP, then Verify OTP (use OTP from response or env). Token is auto-saved to `authToken`; `userId` is set from Verify OTP.
4. Run "19. E2E Test (Run All)" to execute the full flow in sequence.

**Variables:** base_url, phone, pincode, otp, authToken, refreshToken, userId, warehouseId, storeId, addressId, orderId, productId, productVariantId, categoryId, paymentId, notificationId, ratingId, returnId, messageId, appContentLinkId, suggestionId, deliveryRelQueId, orderRatingId, bannerId, deliveryDate, orderItemId, internalSyncKey, cartItemId.

**Create Order:** Requires `warehouseId` (from cart), `addressId`, `deliveryType` (FAST | SCHEDULED | PICKUP_STORE). For SCHEDULED add deliveryDate & deliverySlot; for PICKUP_STORE add pickupTimeSlot.

**Delivery:** GET /delivery/types (warehouseId; optional addressId, pincode, cartValue), GET /delivery/slots (warehouseId, date; optional addressId, pincode for route filtering), POST /delivery/calculate-charge (pincode, subtotal; optional warehouseId, latitude, longitude), GET /delivery/stores/pickup, GET /delivery/stores/:storeId/pickup-slots (optional date). Aligned with Delivery Configuration (WarehouseDeliverySetting, RouteMap, PickupSlot, blackouts).

**Wishlist:** POST /wishlist/add (warehouseId, productId), DELETE /wishlist/remove/:productId, PATCH /wishlist/clear. (Deprecated: Sync Wishlist removed; use Clear Wishlist.)

**Payments:** Razorpay webhook (POST /payments/razorpay/webhook, no auth), Retry (POST /payments/:paymentId/retry).

**Auth:** `verify-otp` returns `accessToken` and `refreshToken` (use `Bearer {{accessToken}}` or map `accessToken` → collection `authToken`). Optional body: `deviceId`, `fcmToken`, `referralCode` (format `AB12345`). **Send/Resend OTP:** MSG91 in production; `503` if SMS fails; `data.otp` only when `NODE_ENV=development`; `data.isNewUser`, `data.smsSkipped` when applicable.

**Device:** `POST /api/v1/updateToken` — FCM / device metadata (requires `userId`, `deviceId`, `deviceToken`).

**Delivery:** `GET /api/v1/delivery/stores/:storeId/pickup-slots` — path param is `storeId` (warehouse UUID from pickup stores list).

**Last updated:** 2026-04 (synced with `services/apiRoutes.js` and routers).

item.name: Send OTP
item.description: POST /api/v1/user/send-otp. Body: phone (required), countryCode (optional, default +91). Success: message, isNewUser; development may include otp. 429 cooldown; 503 if MSG91 fails in production.

item.name: Resend OTP
item.description: POST /api/v1/user/resend-otp. Requires prior send-otp. Same body as Send OTP. Separate resend cooldown. 503 if SMS fails after OTP regeneration.

request.description: POST /api/v1/user/verify-otp. Required: phone, otp. Optional: countryCode, deviceId, fcmToken, referralCode (pattern AB12345). Response data: user, accessToken, refreshToken.
GET /api/v1/user/me. Returns user including totalOrdersCount, totalWishlistCount, isProfileComplete, missingFields, addresses.
PATCH /api/v1/user/update-profile. name + email required by validator; optional gender, dob (ISO), profileImage (URL), address object, referralCode.

POST /api/v1/updateToken. Required: userId, deviceId, deviceToken. Optional: platform (android|ios|web), device metadata, notificationEnabled, isEmulator, isRooted, updatedAt (ISO). No Bearer auth in route — validate userId server-side against your app security model.
Deletes the authenticated user account (soft delete).
Notify location waitlist when pincode is non-serviceable.
GET /api/v1/subcategories. Query: pincode (required), optional latitude, longitude, userId. categoryId in query is not used by the API for filtering (filter client-side if needed).
Fetch subcategories by pincode in body. Optional: latitude, longitude, userId.
Fetch top brands for warehouse by pincode.
Fetch top brands by pincode in body.
Fetch all active virtual bundles for consumer app.
Create a new virtual bundle (Admin). Required: name, bundlePrice, mrp, items[]. Each item needs productId and quantity.
Add a virtual bundle to cart. Required: bundleId, warehouseId. Optional: quantity (default 1), type (inc/dec).

request.description: Add item to cart. **productId** (required). **productVariantId** (optional): when provided, pricing/stock/SKU use the variant; omit for product-only. **quantity** (optional, default 1). **type** (optional): `inc` or `dec` to increment/decrement when item already in cart. Response items include **variant** (id, variantName, sku, unit, status) when added with productVariantId. To test with variant, add to body: "productVariantId": "{{productVariantId}}" (set collection variable productVariantId to a valid variant UUID).

request.description: GET /api/v1/delivery/types. Returns delivery types and charges for the warehouse (WarehouseDeliverySetting or MasterDeliverySetting). Response includes deliveryTypes, warehouse, routeMapIds, blackoutDates for checkout. Auth optional; when provided and addressId omitted, default address is used.

query.description: Optional; for route filtering (slots for address's route)
Optional; for route filtering when addressId not sent

request.description: GET /api/v1/delivery/slots. Returns available delivery slots for warehouse and date. When addressId or pincode provided, only slots for that route (and legacy slots) are returned. Slot id (e.g. 09:00-12:00) is used as deliverySlot in Create Order (SCHEDULED).

POST /api/v1/delivery/calculate-charge. Body: pincode (required), subtotal (required), warehouseId (optional), latitude/longitude (optional for nearest warehouse when warehouseId omitted). Returns deliveryCharge, total, warehouse, freeDeliveryThreshold, isFreeDelivery.
GET /api/v1/delivery/stores/pickup. Returns pickup stores (warehouses with self-pickup). Query: warehouseId, pincode optional.

query.description: Optional; when provided uses PickupSlot table and blackout; when omitted uses legacy pickupTimeSlots

request.description: GET /api/v1/delivery/stores/:storeId/pickup-slots. Path param storeId is the warehouse/store UUID (set {{storeId}} from GET /delivery/stores/pickup response). Query date optional: when set uses PickupSlot + blackout; when omitted returns legacy slots.
Place order with FAST delivery. warehouseId must match cart items.

Place SCHEDULED order. deliverySlot must be a slot id from GET /api/v1/delivery/slots or GET /api/v1/orders/slots/availability (e.g. 09:00-12:00). Validations: delivery type must be enabled in Partner settings; same-day slot start must not be in the past; slot capacity enforced atomically. 400 if type disabled, slot started, or slot full.
Same logic as GET /api/v1/delivery/slots. Returns slots for warehouse and date; slot id may be Partner format (09:00-12:00) or default. Use slot id as deliverySlot in Create Order (SCHEDULED).
